openwrt_wiki.einleitung: Based on the Mediatek MT7620N @ 580MHz; 64MB DDR1, 16MB Flash; USB A port for external storage, 3G dongle, etc with software power control; 300Mbps Wifi N; Dual Ethernet (WAN/LAN); Customised OpenWrt pre-installed from the factory (with GLI Web UI); Configurable 2/3-position toggle switch (requires simple hardware mod for 3 position)
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout: w25q128 16 MiB: mtd0 u-boot 192 KiB, mtd1 u-boot-env 64 KiB, mtd2 factory 64 KiB, mtd3 firmware 15872 KiB (kernel ~1.2 MiB, rootfs), mtd7 art 64 KiB; rootfs_data 8.5 MiB
openwrt_wiki.installation_oem: Install OpenWrt in GL.Inet devices (toh:gl.inet:installation); Browser-Cache: http://192.168.1.1/index.html?index
openwrt_wiki.installation_tftp: TFTP upgrade requires connecting to the Serial port, and pressing spacebar during boot to access the U-Boot command line.
openwrt_wiki.upgrade: LuCI http://192.168.8.1/cgi-bin/luci/admin/system/flashops; sysupgrade oder mtd write ... linux
openwrt_wiki.debricking: U-Boot web interface: LAN port, PC 192.168.1.2/24; router unplugged, press and hold reset, plug in, hold reset at least 3 seconds, release, http://192.168.1.1
openwrt_wiki.netzwerk_oem: br-lan 192.168.8.1/24 (LAN & WiFi); vlan1 eth0.1 LAN port; vlan2 eth0.2 WAN port DHCP; wlan0 disabled
openwrt_wiki.switch_ports: Port 0 = WAN, Port 1 = LAN, Ports 2-5 not present, Port 6 = CPU
openwrt_wiki.typenschild_foto: Rear of the MT300N with Model number, Power rating, Management IP, SSID, Wireless Key, MAC, Serial and Dynamic DNS address. Each MT300N is assigned a Dynamic DNS address unique to your device.
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse_oeffnen: Use a pry tool in the notch indicated. There are clips all round. Note the white post on the cover that holds the PCB steady. Ensure the cover is replaced with the correct orientation.
openwrt_wiki.seriell: The serial port on the MT300N comes with the headers factory fitted. It can be seen between the Ethernet switch (yellow) and PCB port at the bottom of the board and is labelled "TX,RX and GND". 115200, 8N1
openwrt_wiki.gpio: Headers at the top of the board not factory fitted. No label=GPIO 0 (USB-A power), WPS_PBC=GPIO 2 (shared with WPS button, appears not to exist), RST_PBC=GPIO 1 (reset button), 3.3VD=3.3V, LINK4=GPIO 44 unused, LINK3=GPIO 43 (toggle switch)
openwrt_wiki.poe: the board comes with support for a PoE add-on board which can be obtained from GLI; datasheet GL-PD13C050NV (http://www.gl-inet.com/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/GL-PD13C050NV-datasheet.docx)
openwrt_wiki.switch_mod: 3 way toggle switch comes from the factory with the right-hand third of the plastic part filled; mod allows 3 way toggling
openwrt_wiki.schalter_gpio: GPIO 42/43: Left = 42 high, Centre = both low, Right = 43 high; /etc/rc.button/BTN_0, BTN_1
openwrt_wiki.bootlog_oem: U-Boot 1.1.3 (Nov 28 2015); Ralink UBoot Version 4.3.0.0; ASIC 7620_MP; DRAM component: 512 Mbits DDR, width 16; Total memory 64 MBytes; spi device id ef 40 18 -> W25Q128BV; CPU freq 580 MHZ; Hit SPACE to stop autoboot; Kernel 3.18.23: Board has DDR2; SoC Type: MediaTek MT7620N ver:2 eco:6; MIPS 24KEc
openwrt_wiki.bootlog_openwrt: m25p80 spi0.0: w25q128 (16384 Kbytes); port 0 link up (100Mbps/Full duplex); EHCI 1 port; rt2x00: RT chipset 5390, RF chipset 7620
